key_risks: Rapid de-escalation or free transit restoration in Hormuz could reverse oil/energy gains
Higher-than-expected June/July CPI or hawkish FOMC could pressure equities and rates-sensitive holdings
Weak bank earnings or further soft labor data could undermine financials allocation
Broad risk-off from Asia equity weakness or tech spillover could drag even value/energy names

portfolio.rationale: Hormuz blockade restart and dual control claims create near-term upside for energy equities via oil price support before August exit.
Direct crude exposure benefits from unresolved Strait transit risks and announced US Iranian shipping blockade starting July 14.
Upcoming major-bank Q2 results and relative 30d strength position financials for potential outperformance amid rate and growth data.
Defensive sector with strong recent relative returns and lower beta offers ballast if oil-driven inflation or risk-off hits broader market.
Value tilt captures energy/financials exposure with lower growth sensitivity while rates remain elevated.

portfolio_rationale: Concentrate on energy complex for Hormuz catalyst while adding financials and healthcare for earnings and defensive balance over the one-month window. Avoid stretched tech/semis given recent weakness and rate uncertainty.
rationale_summary: Geopolitical oil risk is the dominant near-term price driver; pair with relative-strength sectors less exposed to growth/tech drawdowns ahead of FOMC and CPI prints.
